english.title: Give a false alarm of fire to a person acting on behalf of a fire and rescue authority
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) knowingly gave a false alarm of a fire to **(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..) a person acting on behalf of a fire and rescue authority

english.notes:
As from 08/04/2013 Penalty Notices for Disorder may ONLY be issued to offenders aged 18 years or over.

This offence may be disposed of by the issue of a Penalty Notice for Disorder - PND Code DA03.

(i) See also CJS Code FS04010 and H4696 - for knowingly cause a false alarm to be given
(ii) The prosecutor may apply to the court for an Anti-social Behaviour Order
(iii) The Penalty Notice for Disorder amount rose from £80 to £90 on 01/07/2013
